# Contract: Compare Action

<!-- Generated by Spec-Kit /speckit.plan | Session: a0048076-0ae1-42e8-b25c-9d53f1b17c55 | Date: 2026-01-26 -->

## Overview

Compares two archived sessions side-by-side (FR-011).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `-Action` | string | Yes | - | Must be "Compare" |
| `-Session1` | string | Yes | - | First archive filename or timestamp |
| `-Session2` | string | Yes | - | Second archive filename or timestamp |

## Behavior

1. Load both archive files
2. Validate both are schema version 2.0.0+
3. Calculate deltas for all metrics:
   - Total invocations (count change, %)
   - Total tokens (usage change, %)
   - Success rate (improvement/decline)
   - Model distribution changes
   - Category distribution changes
   - Parallelization efficiency
4. Display side-by-side comparison

## Report Format

```text
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                         SESSION COMPARISON
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Session 2: agent-metrics-20260126-153045.json

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Metric                  Session 1       Session 2       Delta
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Invocations             8               12              +4 (+50%)
  Total Tokens            320,000         480,000         +160,000 (+50%)

  Avg Duration            1m 45s          1m 30s          -15s (-14%) ↓
  Parallel Efficiency     75%             85%             +10% ↑

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Model       Session 1          Session 2          Change
              Count   Cost%      Count   Cost%
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Opus        3       40%        2       25%        ↓ fewer, cheaper
  Sonnet      4       50%        8       60%        ↑ more usage
  Haiku       1       10%        2       15%        → stable

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                              AGENT COMPARISON
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Agent                Session 1       Session 2       Delta
                       Count  Tokens   Count  Tokens
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  backend-developer    4      180k     6      270k     +2 (+50%)
  test-engineer        3      120k     4      180k     +1 (+33%)
  code-reviewer        1      20k      2      30k      +1 (+100%)

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  ↑ More invocations but better success rate
  ↑ Shifted away from expensive Opus to Sonnet
  ↑ Improved parallelization efficiency
  ↓ Token usage increased 50% - monitor for trends
```

## Session Selection

Sessions can be specified by:
- Full filename: `agent-metrics-20260120-103045.json`
- Timestamp only: `20260120-103045`
- Date only (picks latest): `20260120`

## Preconditions

- Both session files exist in archive directory
- Both have schema version 2.0.0+

## Postconditions

- Report displayed (not persisted)

## Example

```powershell
.\agent-metrics.ps1 -Action Compare -Session1 "20260120" -Session2 "20260126"
```

## Error Handling

| Error | Behavior |
|-------|----------|
| Session not found | Exit with "Session not found: {name}" |
| Ambiguous date | List matching sessions, ask for specificity |
| Legacy schema | Exit with "Session {name} is legacy format (pre-2.0.0)" |
